title: BlueYeti Earns Snowflake Select Services Partner Designation Amid Growing Demand for AI-Ready Data Infrastructure
text:
BlueYeti , a fast-rising consultancy in modern data architecture and AI enablement, announced it has achieved Select Services Partner status with Snowflake, the AI Data Cloud company. The designation affirms BlueYeti’s position as a specialized technical partner focused on AI readiness, Snowflake performance optimization, and secure, scalable data cloud infrastructure.
With AI-native architectures surging across industries, BlueYeti has become a trusted implementation partner for organizations seeking to operationalize Snowflake for real-time decision-making, automation, and analytics. The company’s focus on high-performance, cost-efficient data environments is attracting both enterprise clients and tech leaders.
“This is a major milestone for our team and validation of the high-impact work we’ve delivered,” said Frederick DeWorken, Founder & CEO of BlueYeti. “We're helping clients scale AI-enabled infrastructure while driving performance, security, and cost-efficiency.”
BlueYeti’s services include data integration, cloud migrations, governance, reverse ETL, and AI/ML deployment—led by certified teams across the modern data stack. A key differentiator is the firm’s use of Snowflake-native agents to power everything from automated analysis to AI co-pilots.
“The BlueYeti team worked quickly and efficiently to successfully build Snowflake-native agents trained on Tealium data and documentation,” said Dave Datars, VP of Business Development at Tealium. “One agent can act as a data analyst, another as a Tealium co-pilot. We look forward to seeing them implement more Snowflake + Tealium agent use cases.”
To match client needs, BlueYeti offers three engagement models:
Expert Augmentation for rapid skills gap coverage Dedicated Data Teams for end-to-end delivery On-Demand Projects with flexible scopes and no long-term commitments Clients report average savings of 58% compared to full-time hires, while gaining technical depth and strategic speed. The firm’s pillars—AI readiness, data security, and Snowflake efficiency—are embedded in every engagement.
As AI adoption scales, BlueYeti is positioning itself at the intersection of architecture simplicity, business value, and intelligent automation.
About BlueYeti
BlueYeti is a Modern Data Stack Center of Excellence specializing in Snowflake architecture, AI infrastructure, and agentic workflows. With global delivery and deep technical talent, BlueYeti helps enterprises unlock the full power of their modern data stacks. BlueYeti Assessments are available in the AWS Marketplace and coming soon to Azure Marketplace.
